mechanics.claim: Passive on-hit damage can critically strike.
mechanics.quote: This damage can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|170|50}}|critical damage}} damage

mechanics.claim: The second strike applies on-hit effects and can crit independently of the primary attack.
mechanics.quote: The second strike rolls {{tip|critical strikes}} independently from the primary attack.

mechanics.claim: Damaging abilities apply the mark but can't be consumed for the second strike unless it's a basic attack (or on-hit-applying ability damage).
mechanics.quote: Ability damage that applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects (''e.g.'', {{ais|R|Viego}} damage against the primary target) cannot apply the mark but can consume it, as a basic attack would.

mechanics.claim: No second strike occurs if the first attack was dodged, blocked, or missed.
mechanics.quote: '''Viego''' will not perform the second strike if the first attack was {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, {{tip|blocked|blocked}}, and {{tip|blind|missed}}.

mechanics.claim: If the second strike hits a dead unit, Viego still heals based on the post-mitigation damage it would have dealt.
mechanics.quote: If the second strike hits a dead unit, '''Viego''' will still {{tip|heal}} based on the post-mitigation damage that he would deal with it.

mechanics.claim: Neither the passive bonus damage nor the second strike bonus damage apply against structures.
mechanics.quote: The attacks do not deal the '''bonus''' damage against {{tip|structures}}.

mechanics.claim: The mark does not cause a second attack windup; on-attack triggers only fire once.
mechanics.quote: The mark does not cause '''Viego''' to attack twice. Effects that trigger {{tip|on-attack}} or interact with the attack windup will only trigger once and thus do not interact with ''Blade of the Ruined King''.

mechanics.claim: The active thrust deals area damage, the second strike deals basic damage, and the passive on-hit deals proc damage (separate damage instances).
mechanics.quote:
{{Tip|Area damage}} for the thrust.
** {{Tip|Basic damage}} for the second strike.
** {{Tip|Proc damage}} for the on-hit bonus damage.

mechanics.claim: Damage from the active applies at cast time end.
